label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is 'safe' (derived from param.replace('-->') which retains unencoded user input). Although wrapped in HTML comment delimiters, the application fails to perform proper HTML entity encoding on the user-supplied data. Relying on comment syntax and partial string replacement ('-->' removal) is insufficient to prevent XSS, as other malicious payloads (e.g., '<script>', event handlers) remain executable or exploitable depending on context/parsing. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input 'param' retrieved from request flows to 'safe' via replace('-->') and is written to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding.
